title: Guided Setup Spotlight — compact carousel + contextual help hover states
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and hand off a compact, progressive 'Guided Setup Spotlight' carousel for Console first-run flow that surfaces a concise checklist, contextual inline tips on hover, and lightweight empty-state illustrations. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success for new users by providing an unobtrusive, skippable tour that adapts to account size and locale. Deliverables: Figma component kit (desktop/tablet/mobile), SVG/PNG exports, Lottie micro-animations for spotlight pulse, copy variants for 3 locales, accessibility notes and a dev-handoff token list.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file includes a single reusable carousel component with variants: collapsed/expanded/compact, and breakpoints for 1280/768/375 widths
Each carousel card contains: title (40 char max), 1-line hint, CTA (primary) and tertiary skip link; hover shows contextual help tooltip with keyboard focus states
Empty-state illustration set exported in SVG and 2x PNG for three sizes; illustrations decompose into layer groups for theming
Lottie micro-animation exported (.json) with <1s loop for spotlight pulse; performance budget under 50KB minified
Copy approved for en-US, es-ES and de-DE with localization tokens in design file
Accessibility doc included: contrast matrix, keyboard interaction table, aria attributes for carousel and tooltips
Handoff checklist completed with table of exported assets, tokens, animation specs and suggested CSS classes
